record_fields.name: dim
record_fields.human_derivation: Use multisegment exhaustion; each cuspidal support parameter has the correct dimension. Characteristic polynomials multiply over segment terms, and monic degree adds to rank.

record_fields.name: one
record_fields.exact: one : ∀ χ hχ, rc (.ofChar χ hχ) = WD.lpOfChar h (χ.comp a) (ha.smooth hχ)
record_fields.human_derivation: A rank-one smooth character is cuspidal, hence the extension equals the original cuspidal map, which sends it to its Artin pullback.

record_fields.name: langlands
record_fields.exact:
langlands : ∀ (l : List (Segment (w.adicCompletion E))) (x : IrrGL (w.adicCompletion E)),
    IsL (l : Multiset (Segment (w.adicCompletion E))) x.rep → rc x = segSum rc l
record_fields.human_derivation: The chosen extension sums r on segments. Each first term is cuspidal, so replace r by rc pointwise in the list map; the same sum is segSum rc l.

record_fields.name: cusp
record_fields.human_derivation: On a cuspidal x, rc x = r x, and the original cusp map has irreducible WD value.

record_fields.name: nu
record_fields.exact: nu : ∀ x (s : ℝ), rc (x.nu s) = (rc x).lpTw s
record_fields.human_derivation: Twisting by real absolute powers is compatible with classification and each segment; applies without Good.

record_fields.root_application_anchor: exact hT.2 x χ hχ hg

critical_distinctions: GoodCusp is rank one OR a smooth twist of a class with nonzero KOne-fixed vectors at a completion continuously isomorphic to Q_p. Good means existence of a support all of whose terms satisfy GoodCusp. Neither is universal.

inj requires Good y only, not Good x and not no guard. Exact central and arbitrary character twist require Good x; absolute central and real-power twist do not. The type condition is a separate universally quantified implication, not an unconditional tameness statement.

The theorem provides a total map with conditional laws, not full unguarded local Langlands correspondence, nor a proof of surjectivity. Do not interpret Published names as validated historical citations.

def TypeLaw (rc : IrrGL (w.adicCompletion E) → WD h) : Prop :=
  ∀ (E' : Type) [Field E'] [NumberField E'] [Algebra E E'] [Algebra E' Ω] [IsScalarTower E E' Ω] [IsAlgClosure E' Ω]
    (g : ℕ) [Fact g.Prime] (w' : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 E')) (h' : IsPlaceOver A w'),
    ∀ (i : ℚ_[g] ≃+* w.adicCompletion E), Continuous i →
    ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ((g : ℕ) : 𝓞 E') ∉ w'.asIdeal ^ 2 → normV w' = g ^ n →
    ∀ a' : Weil h' →* (w'.adicCompletion E')ˣ, IsLocalArtin h' a' →
    ∀ (K : Type) [Field K] [Algebra (ZMod g) K] (red : 𝓞 E' →+* K), Function.Surjective red →
      RingHom.ker red = w'.asIdeal →
    ∀ θ : Kˣ →* ℂˣ, GlobalTheory.Published.IsRegularChar g n θ →
    ∀ τ : FDRep ℂ (Gn g n), IsCusp τ.character →
      (∀ y : Gn g n, Irreducible (y : Mt g n).charpoly → ∀ z : Kˣ, aeval (z : K) (y : Mt g n).charpoly = 0 →
        τ.character y = (-1) ^ (n - 1) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, ((θ (z ^ g ^ j) : ℂˣ) : ℂ)) →
    ∀ σ : GlobalTheory.SmGL.IrrRep (GL (Fin n) (w.adicCompletion E)),
      GlobalTheory.SerSys.TameGen.Inflates (σ.ρ.comp (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map i.toRingHom)) τ →
      (rc (cls σ)).mono0 ∧
      ∀ (t : Ine (F := E') A) (x : 𝓞 E') (z : Kˣ), red x = z →
        Valued.v ((a' (ineIncl h' t) : w'.adicCompletion E') - algebraMap E' (w'.adicCompletion E') (x : E')) < 1 →
        (rc (cls σ)).inePol (AlgEquiv.restrictScalars E (t : G E' Ω)) =
          ∏ j ∈ Finset.range n, (X - C ((θ (z ^ g ^ j) : ℂˣ) : ℂ))

def GoodCusp (y : IrrGL k) : Prop :=
  y.1 = 1 ∨ ((∃ (g : ℕ) (_ : Fact g.Prime) (i : ℚ_[g] ≃+* k), Continuous i) ∧
    ∃ (y₀ : IrrGL k) (χ : kˣ →* ℂˣ) (hχ : IsSmoothChar χ), GlobalTheory.PRep.fixed y₀.rep (GlobalTheory.SplitWeil.KOne k (Fin y₀.1)) ≠ ⊥ ∧ y = y₀.tw χ hχ)

def Good (x : IrrGL k) : Prop := ∃ s, HasSupport x.rep s ∧ ∀ y ∈ s, GoodCusp y
